products.name: TUNAS
products.tagline: Personal AI for your own notebook, PC or phone. It runs on the device, offline and private, on its own or with your organisation's TERAS.
platforms: Phones and tablets, Android 9 or later
products.note: Already have TUNAS? It checks for a new version once a day and offers Update by itself.
install: Windows 10 or 11: run the installer. It installs for you alone, with no administrator password. If SmartScreen warns, choose More info, then Run anyway.

Mac (macOS 11 or later): open the disk image and drag TUNAS into Applications. This build is not yet signed by Apple: run this once in Terminal, then open TUNAS:
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/TUNAS.app
Android 9 or later (64-bit): open the downloaded file and allow installing apps from your browser or Files app. If Play Protect warns, choose More details, then Install anyway.
